correctness.rationale: For each length-at-least-three directed cycle, summing the prescribed row-gap inequalities against predecessors yields its mean-gap lower bound on absolute reciprocal payoff error. The explicit positive construction uses forward/reverse cycle edges differing by that mean and symmetric depth-decaying tree edges; all other gaps are controlled by a large base B and step L. Exact rational exhaustive replay validates 50,069 instances through six types; separate LP optima agree on 283 instances. The general proof, not the finite tests, establishes all n and positive real margin vectors.

value.rationale: For an existing partner-choice equilibrium model whose unrestricted phase space contains every functional graph, the theorem solves the motivated inverse problem of minimum numerical payoff non-reciprocity needed to implement any chosen topology at quantitative heterogeneous incentive strength. This yields an exact sharp budget transition; the already-known graph count measures how restrictive reciprocity becomes but is not part of the claimed novelty. The problem is structurally meaningful and its weighted all-size optimum is not a routine example.
